Pi coding-agent core: ownership and retained references
|
|-- CLI hosts: InteractiveMode / runPrintMode / runRpcMode
|   `-- -> consume AgentSessionRuntime; subscribe to session events
|
|-- SDK factory: createAgentSession()
|   |-- Restored branch + settings + options -> model/thinking/tools
|   `-- -> constructs Agent and AgentSession; runtime wrapper optional
|
`-- AgentSessionRuntime [agent-session-runtime.ts]
    |-- Current AgentSession [agent-session.ts]
    |   |-- API: prompt / steer / followUp / abort / compact / navigateTree
    |   |   `-- state/messages/model getters; subscribe(listener)
    |   |-- Agent [retained execution engine; agent.ts]
    |   |   |-- _state: messages, model, thinking, tools, streaming/error state
    |   |   |-- steeringQueue / followUpQueue; activeRun + abort controller
    |   |   `-- prompt()/continue() -> agent-loop functions
    |   |-- SessionManager [retained canonical history; session-manager.ts]
    |   |   `-- Owns entry tree and selected leaf; Agent messages are a projection
    |   |-- ExtensionRunner [created and bound by _buildRuntime()]
    |   |   `-- -> ResourceLoader extensions; session context and hook dispatch
    |   |-- Tool registries: definitions + wrapped callable implementations
    |   |   `-- _refreshToolRegistry() -> installs Agent tool loadout
    |   |-- Run bookkeeping and recovery controllers
    |   |   |-- prompt preflight, pending messages, retry and settlement state
    |   |   |-- Compaction / branch-summary / retry / bash cancellation
    |   |   `-- compact()/recovery -> history entries; refresh Agent context
    |   |-- Agent subscription and public listener collection
    |   |   `-- Events -> extension hooks -> listeners; message_end -> history
    |   |-- CacheWarmer [retained optional helper]
    |   |-- Service references -> runtime services below
    |   `-- dispose()
    |       `-- Abort; invalidate extension contexts; detach; cancel/clean resources
    |
    |-- AgentSessionServices [cwd-bound infrastructure bundle]
    |   |-- cwd / agentDir / diagnostics
    |   |-- SettingsManager [created or supplied]
    |   |-- ResourceLoader [extensions, skills, templates]
    |   `-- ModelRuntime [created or supplied; provider/model/auth boundary]
    |
    `-- Replacement operations: newSession / switchSession / fork
        |-- Before-switch/fork hooks may cancel
        |-- teardownCurrent() -> await session.abort() and idle settlement
        |-- -> session_shutdown hooks -> host UI invalidation -> dispose()
        `-- -> factory -> apply new session/services -> rebindSession()
